subject: general
question: In which city is the Rajghat memorial situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajghat** is a memorial dedicated to **Mahatma Gandhi** in Delhi, India.
 
• It is located on the banks of the **Yamuna river**.
 
• The memorial is a simple square platform made of black marble, marking the spot where Mahatma Gandhi was cremated on January 31, 1948.
 
• Rajghat is a significant site for visitors, including various dignitaries from around the world, who pay their respects to the Father of the Nation.
 
• The site is surrounded by a beautiful park with labeled trees planted by various dignitaries and heads of state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahatma Gandhi** was an influential leader of the Indian independence movement against British rule.
 
• He is known for his philosophy of **non-violence (Ahimsa)** and his role in leading India to independence through peaceful civil disobedience.
 
• The Rajghat memorial is a place of national importance and is visited by millions of people every year.
 
• Special ceremonies are held at Rajghat on **Gandhi Jayanti** (October 2) and other significant days.
 
• The site also features an **Eternal Flame** that burns continuously in honor of Mahatma Gandhi's memory.
